comment: Sanctioned upward-closure violations. Each entry suppresses exactly the listed missing items at the named site; when the repair lands the entry goes stale and fails the gate until removed. 'pending' names the worktree branch that owns the fix; 'evidence' documents why the set is deliberately not upward-closed.

exceptions.reason: The 5.2.03 editor-model record drops eight morph-target/part selectors the 5.2.02 record carried.
exceptions.evidence: Deliberate exact-use truncation: records admit only the selectors the runtime slice actually consumes, and the >=5.2.03 editor-model generation does not consume these eight aliases. Backfilling them would assert unverified internal member names, so the regression is recorded as an explicit exception rather than papered over.

exceptions.reason: The 5.3.02 editor-model record drops the same eight morph-target/part selectors the 5.3.01 record carried.
exceptions.evidence: Deliberate exact-use truncation: records admit only the selectors the runtime slice actually consumes, and the >=5.3.02 editor-model generation does not consume these eight aliases. Backfilling them would assert unverified internal member names, so the regression is recorded as an explicit exception rather than papered over.

exceptions.reason: artifactProfile's case arms look like a version set.
exceptions.evidence: The switch is an identity mapping: 'default -> reviewedVersion' passes every admitted version through unchanged; the two case arms exist only as the single place a profile-id divergence would live.

exceptions.evidence: Property-gated validation diagnostic (turboism.validation.editorTextureReplaceDiagnostic) that was authored and reviewed against the exact 5.3.02 host; it is a diagnostic tool, not a capability admission set.

exceptions.evidence: The guard only selects the optional 5.3.03 validation-candidate runtime scope (admits5303ValidationCandidate); every reviewed artifact still gets a resolver with a null extra scope.
